title: The PERFECT Reality Fracture Draft!
event: FRA early access / preview event (he thanks Wizards for free preview access at 0:04-0:07 'so I could get this recorded early'; event type not named; format (Premier / Quick) not shown)
source: frames read from data/videos/raw/pdITCHUnEa8 (tools/video_draft.py frames); pack lists read from frames that loaded, takes confirmed by the pool strips and the deck builder (sideboard); transcript from YouTube auto captions, card names corrected; nothing past 22:40 read; the game starts after 22:40

colour_path.quote: I'm trying not to draft with too many color preferences early days.
I've been struggling against green white a bit and I have two Marwins and a heartwood crafter for maybe I build green white.
looking like I'll be a red green back here.
Maybe play a blue red deck because we only have three green cards
we are definitely playing red and we are probably playing red green and maybe we'll play red blue.
if red and blue are open, we'll end up with a great deck. If just red is open, we'll end up with a pretty good deck.
We're officially moving into red blue.
We're we're committed at this point.
Switching to blue worked out well.

picks.reasoning: Takes the mythic: a two-for-one creature with flashback on an instant or sorcery in the graveyard; many good spells to flash back. Liliana is the rare but he rates Stingcaster higher.

considered.Liliana the Faultless: was impressive against him but mostly because of a Lyra deck; expects someone to take it
considered.Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive: really strong; expects someone to take it

quotes: Stingcaster Mage is great. It enters and floods you flashback in his inner sorcery.
it's going to be a very efficient like two for one creature that you're going to be happy to have.

picks.reasoning: Between Marwyn (the 2-mana 3/2) and Skilled Battlecarver; picks Marwyn because it is bigger ('getting stats out there'), not biasing towards a colour yet. Take confirmed by the pool strip (two Preservers by P1p9).

considered.Marwyn, the Clearcutter: some aggro 2-for-1 but he does not prioritise it: you rarely feel good sacrificing a land and there are few artifacts
considered.Skilled Battlecarver: an option as a fairly aggressive two-drop
considered.Way of the Healer: gets a couple of 2/2s and surveils, but slow and interactable

quotes: I'm trying not to draft with too many color preferences early days.
I think I'm just going to take the Marwin. It's just bigger.

picks.reasoning: Highest upside of fine options; gives mana for activated abilities (the Marwyn ability) and early game; the mana cannot be spent on spells from hand but can on flashback.
quotes: I think Heartwood Crafter is probably the highest upside here.
Get myself some more early game.

picks.reasoning: Wants to keep taking Marwyns while they come: two let him build around them.

considered.Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer: double strike prowess is no joke for four mana

quotes: I feel like we just want to keep taking Marwins though while we're seeing them.
We get two of them, we can build around that a little bit more.

picks.reasoning: Counter plus six damage is a good rate; would have been great with Tetsuko.

considered.Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer: regrets not having taken it earlier

quotes: I do like awaken the Inferno a lot. Counter plus deal six, just a good rate.

picks.reasoning: Feels he has been struggling against green-white; two Marwyns and Heartwood Crafter point to green-white or Nia. Takes the high-upside card; says later it is probably not making the cut.

considered.Command the Stage: has not seen it do anything; only good if supported in black-red

quotes: Here I might just take vigor bloom charm.
I think I'll just take the the high upside card.

picks.reasoning: Easiest No Admittance of his life; has been trying to play Eye of Jace, but No Admittance is the easy pick, and good with Stingcaster Mage.

considered.Eye of Jace: does some things good, some things bad

quotes: Easiest no admittance of my life.

picks.reasoning: Cheap removal that is really good with Stingcaster Mage; cheap legendaries already in the pool make its cost reduction work. Now says red-green: eight picks in, all red and green cards except Vigorbloom.
quotes: Wrath of the blood mane really good with stinger caster mage.
So looking like I'll be a red green back here.

picks.reasoning: Tetsuko is better if it lives, but Puller is the better card; red looks wide open in this draft.

considered.Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer: better than Puller if it lives, but Puller is just a better card

quotes: Tetsuko is like if it lives, it's better than the Polar, but Polar is just a better card. And red looks wide open in this draft.

picks.reasoning: Two red cards in the pack; Marwyn is really good when you have two Marwyn the Preservers, a late-game engine; a 2/1 that draws cards late beats the 2/1 first striker. Hover tag first sat on Skilled Battlecarver; pool strip at P1p12 shows Clearcutter.
picks.plan: Red open, 'we should be getting a really sweet deck'.
quotes: I think Marwin is really good when you have two Marwin the Preservers.
red is completely open here

pack_cards: unreadable (4th card hidden by hover popup)
picks.reasoning: Doubts Blazing Crescendo ('not good in other formats'); takes the creature to give it a shot. Pool strip at P1p12 shows Tether Technician.

considered.Blazing Crescendo: has not been good in other formats

quotes: Is Blazing Crescendo any good? I mean, it has not been good in other formats. So, let's just take this guy and at least give him a shot.

picks.reasoning: Speculates on the best card in the pack: only three green cards so far, so maybe blue-red; her ability is good with all his one-toughness creatures. Caption says 'we'll take Emberling' but the pool strip at P1p13 shows Tetsuko Fugitive and no Emberling.
picks.plan: Red plus green or blue (speculating blue).
quotes: maybe we'll just speculate on this. Maybe play a blue red deck because we only have three green cards
it's not like a huge draw into green by any stretch

picks.reasoning: Takes the blue-red land as speculation: 'bobbing and weaving'; definitely red, probably red-green, maybe red-blue.
picks.plan: Definitely red; green or blue second.
quotes: We're going to take the blue red land.
we are definitely playing red and we are probably playing red green and maybe we'll play red blue.

picks.reasoning: Last card; no comment.
Best card in the pack by a mile; can abandon the green cards if needed. Argues swingy cards that must be answered win games, and he already has a land (Innovative Commons) for its hard mana cost.

considered.Loot, the Nexus: will not do anything crazy for him

picks.plan: Red base, blue or green second; green looks less tempting than blue.
quotes: I think we just take the Lyra.
having a card like Lyra is going to win me like one or two games over the course of my run

picks.reasoning: Rare for blue-red in the pack. Frostbite Pyromental (deal damage, draw two) is good but hard to cast and does not help attack a planeswalker; he would rather have the giant flier.

considered.Frostbite Pyromental: reasonable but hard to cast; the giant flier might be better

quotes: I think the giant flyer might be better.
We're officially moving into red blue.

picks.reasoning: Third-pick bomb rare in blue; he would have been rewarded for red-green (Craftwork Crusher in the pack) but is being rewarded for blue. Nobody seems to be in blue or red.

considered.Craftwork Crusher: would have been a great payoff for red-green

quotes: Craft work crusher would have been a great payoff for red green.
we're getting a third pick bomb rare in blue.

picks.reasoning: A five-mana 5/5 flier is good even without artifact tokens; takes it over Awaken the Inferno. Plans to prioritise cards that make Heartwood tokens.
quotes: It's also just a five five for five flying anyway. So we're going to take it for sure over awaken the inferno.

picks.reasoning: A whiff pack ('only artifact tokens'). Witness over Rockfall Vale on the off chance of splashing green, though he calls it 'kind of terrible'; the blue-green and red-green cards are not ones he wants to splash. Take confirmed by pool strip.

considered.Rockfall Vale: only for a possible green splash

quotes: I'll take the undulating witness.

picks.reasoning: Loves Traxos: annoying even at four mana, scary cast alongside a three-drop on turn five.

considered.Traxos, Scourge Eternal: not the greatest but a synergy piece with prowess

quotes: Traxxas is so sweet.

picks.reasoning: Four-mana 4/3 that taps their stuff and can give his creatures pseudo-haste is way better than Emberling; buys a lot of time. Take confirmed by the pool strip.

considered.Chandra's Emberling: does not mind it, Hapatra is way better

quotes: I think this card is just way better though. 4 three buys you a lot of time by tapping their stuff.

picks.reasoning: Deck is coming together: all the four-drops and five-drops needed. Takes the Heckler for a cheaper curve.
quotes: Let's take the Heckler.
Currently looking for a couple more two drops.

picks.reasoning: Said he would not take more four-drops, but it curves from Lyra: Lyra into Awakening draws a card, so three cards drawn that turn and another 3/3. Four-drop slot complete.
quotes: You curve Lyra into the uh awakening and then immediately draw a card and then you've drawn three cards and you get another three three

picks.reasoning: Pyromental over Cryotheory Adept: few non-creatures for the Adept's prowess.

considered.Cryotheory Adept: does not have that many non-creatures

quotes: I rather have that or the Cryo Theory

picks.reasoning: Takes the draw/removal aura to give it a shot and gain experience for the format. Notes Craftwork Crusher is still coming around, 'we would have been so rewarded for our red green'.

considered.Craftwork Crusher: still coming around late, which shows red-green was open

quotes: we'll just take infinite course work. Now, the fact that craft work crusher is still coming around is crazy.
We're we're committed at this point.

picks.reasoning: Another kill spell.
quotes: We get another kill spell, so that's nice.

picks.reasoning: Green-white pack, 'not useful for us'. Take read from the deck-builder sideboard (Flourishing Grapple is there, Something Worth Saving is not); not stated aloud.
quotes: Okay, green white. Not not useful for us.

picks.reasoning: Last card: a two-drop 'blast pick', useful.
quotes: Oh, nice. We got a two drop blast pick. That's useful.

picks.reasoning: Another Tetsuko: a lot of his cards work with it (many 2/1 and 3/1 creatures). Hopes to wheel a red card.
quotes: We're just going to take another Tetssuko. A lot of our cards work with it.
Try to wheel a red card though.

picks.reasoning: Good but not great in his deck (few non-creatures, little surveil for Proft); wants another good instant to flash back with Stingcaster Mage, and instant-speed removal.

considered.Proft, Consulting Detective: needs surveil, of which he has little

quotes: Another good instant speed removal spell is going to be great for our deck.

picks.reasoning: Many good options (No Admittance, Unsummon, Heartstring Puller) but Sphinx is 'messed up', so a near-forced take; hopes No Admittance and Puller wheel (both did).
quotes: I think this card is just messed up, so we got to take it pretty much.

picks.reasoning: Considers Unsummon for tempo because the curve is high, then decides to take another kill spell; has a decent number of legends for the cost reduction.

considered.Unsummon: wanted more tempo, deck a bit high on the curve

quotes: Maybe I am supposed to just take Wrath. Let's get another kill spell.

picks.reasoning: Variable Chaser or a two-drop (Eardrum Rattler): the Rattler is much worse, takes the high quality prowess creature.
quotes: I think that card is much worse. Let's just take the high quality card, the prowess creature.

picks.reasoning: Does not have many two-drop creatures; Room of Refuge not needed (already one dual); takes the Jiang as a good card, an attacking one.

considered.Command the Stage: not many two-drop creatures; passes it

quotes: I think Jen is also pretty nice just as a good good card.

picks.reasoning: Already two Wraths; a second Awaken is a guaranteed kill spell, whereas Fblthp feels finicky.
quotes: I'd rather just get a good kill spell. Guaranteed.

picks.reasoning: Another Fulminous Forte over a Marwyn and over another top-end flier (Ruric Thar).
quotes: Another Fulminis Forte over a Marwin. Sure. Over another topend flyer.

picks.reasoning: Gets the two-drop back; the deck needed more early game. Expects to wheel many of the red cards he wanted.
quotes: And we do get the two drop back. So that's actually pretty great for us.

picks.reasoning: One Twinned Vision is really good in this deck: some ways to discard it, likes the effect; does not need the two-drop (Rattler) much since two-drops came back.

considered.Eardrum Rattler: does not need the two-drop that much

quotes: I think one twin division is really good in this sort of deck.

picks.reasoning: No Admittance wheels: 'that's huge for us'. Heartstring Puller would also be good.
quotes: Oh my gosh, we got no admittance to come around. That's huge.

picks.reasoning: A second Pyromental.
quotes: got a pyrnmental. We got two of them now.

picks.reasoning: Another two-drop option if he needs it.
quotes: Okay, we got another two drops. So, we have the options if we need them.

picks.reasoning: Last pick; expects to shave removal and to cut it. 'Switching to blue worked out well.'
quotes: Switching to blue worked out well. Last pick. Infinite coursework.
